node.statement: By definition of matrix amplification, h_{2n}(Z)=(h_n(Z_ij))_ij. Applying ax_R1 in the operator target to the scalar row/column compressions gives ||h_n(Z_ij)||<=||h_{2n}(Z)|| for each i,j. Since ||h_n(T)||>=a_n||T|| for every T (including T=0 by linearity), ||h_{2n}(Z)||>=a_n max_ij||Z_ij||>=a_n||Z||/2. Taking the infimum over nonzero Z yields a_{2n}>=a_n/2. This supplies exactly the domain block estimate and target compression requested by challenge ch-9e80b0efc1ab725e.
